originalTitle: Dollar treads water as Fed hike bets pared on benign US inflation
simplifiedContent: The value of the US dollar stopped going up because some new information about inflation in the US came out and it was better than expected. This made investors think that the Federal Reserve might not raise interest rates as soon as they thought, so they changed their bets. As a result, the dollar's value didn't change much on Thursday, but it's still having a good week overall. This matters because interest rate changes can affect the economy and the stock market, so investors are paying close attention to what the Federal Reserve might do. The news also affected how other currencies are doing compared to the dollar, with some going up and some going down.

originalTitle: South Korea's Kospi swings from bear to bull market in just a month. Is AI trade regaining strength?
simplifiedContent: The stock market in South Korea, called the Kospi, has had a big turnaround in just one month. It was doing poorly, but now it's doing well, with a 31% increase from its low point in July. This is largely because two big companies, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, have seen their stock prices go up, which is making people more hopeful about companies that make chips related to artificial intelligence. Some experts think the market might keep going up, but they're also warning that it could be more unpredictable. This matters because it could mean good things for investors who own stocks in these companies or in the South Korean market.

originalTitle: Muthoot Fincorp files draft papers for Rs 3,000 cr IPO to boost capital base
simplifiedContent: Muthoot Fincorp, a financial company, is planning to raise Rs 3,000 crore through an Initial Public Offering (IPO). This means they want to sell shares of their company to the public to collect money. The company wants to use this money to make its business stronger and help it grow. Muthoot Fincorp has been doing well, especially with its gold loan business, and has seen increased profits and revenue recently. By raising more capital, the company can expand its operations and improve its services, which could be good news for investors and customers.

originalTitle: Milky Mist Dairy Food IPO Day 3 LIVE: GMP, subscription status to review. Apply or not?
simplifiedContent: Here's a simplified version of the news: Milky Mist Dairy Food, a company, is selling its shares to the public for the first time, known as an Initial Public Offering (IPO). On the third day of the IPO, people are watching how many shares are being bought and at what price. Right now, the company's shares are being traded unofficially (in the "grey market") for a price that's ₹22 higher than their official price. This means that some people are willing to pay extra to buy these shares before they're officially available. This could be a sign of strong interest in the company, which might make its shares more attractive to potential buyers.

originalTitle: Newly-listed stock Waterways Leisure Tourism declares record date for 1:10 stock split; details here
simplifiedContent: Waterways Leisure Tourism, a newly listed company, is splitting its shares into smaller pieces. This means that for every one share you own, you will soon get nine more, so you'll have a total of 10 shares. The company has set August 26 as the date to determine who is eligible for this split. If you own shares by this date, you'll get the extra shares. This is happening because the company's board approved the split on July 10, which aims to make the shares more affordable by dividing them into smaller units.

originalTitle: Tour, travel stock under  ₹200 jumps 7% despite weak trends in Indian stock market; here's why
simplifiedContent: A company called Mach Travel Solutions, which is in the tour and travel business, saw its stock price go up by 7% on Thursday. This happened even though the overall stock market in India was not doing well. The reason for the increase is that the company released its financial results for the April-June period, and they were better than expected. This made investors happy and they started buying more of the company's stock, causing the price to rise. The stock price is still relatively low, under ₹200, which might make it more appealing to some investors.
